page.overview:
What is Risu Risu no Mi, Model: Ratatoskr?

The Risu Risu no Mi, Model: Ratatoskr is a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit that grants the power to transform into a hybrid or full version of Ratatoskr, a legendary ice squirrel of ancient times. The fruit was "eaten" by the giant warhammer Ragnir.

The user is capable of producing ice and freezing mists that can flash-freeze targets. According to Loki, anyone frozen by Ragnir cannot thaw until Ragnir wills it; even an Omen blast from Nerona Imu was unable to break it. However, when Ragnir accidentally collided with the ice, it instantly started to thaw. By having the ice crystals collide with each other, the user can generate and amplify lightning, thus making it a good partner for Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr which produces lightning. The user is capable of unleashing ice attacks even when not transformed, making Ragnir doubly effective in its original hammer form. No weaknesses are currently known aside from the standard Devil Fruit weaknesses.

As a hammer, the transmutation of the fruit's abilities has given Ragnir sentience, allowing it to use its tremendous power entirely of its own accord and select a worthy wielder. In conjunction with its current wielder Loki, Ragnir frequently generates either lightning or ice when Loki swings it to attack.

Elbaph legend holds that Ratatoskr was once the companion of the Warrior God many centuries ago, with the Warrior God also wielding Ragnir. When the Warrior God died, it is believed that the spirit of Ratatoskr inhabited Ragnir. The accuracy of this account is currently uncertain, but by gaining the powers of this fruit, Ragnir did receive Ratatoskr's goal of protecting the Warrior God's Devil Fruit, the Ryu Ryu no Mi, Model: Nidhöggr, which it did for centuries until being bested by Loki, who gained Ragnir as his weapon.
